author: BernieSanders
text:
Elon Musk spent $290 million to elect Trump.

His investment worked. He is now $438 billion richer.

Now, he wants to buy Congress by spending $100 million to keep Republicans in control.

We must fight oligarchy. Defeat Musk. Preserve democracy.

author: BernieSanders
text:
United Auto Workers President Shawn Fain is right.

The Michigan Senate race isn't just about Abdul El-Sayed vs. Haley Stevens. It's about whether we continue to have a government of, by and for the billionaire class — or whether working people finally take back power.

author: BernieSanders
text:

2026: $15,474

Has your income kept up with these rising prices? Probably not. That's why so many are struggling.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Why is the establishment so nervous about @AbdulElSayed?

If he wins the MI Senate primary, the entire country will see that we CAN defeat $60 million in billionaire-backed super PAC spending and work towards a government that represents all people, not just the few.

author: BernieSanders
text:
If voters in California approve the 5% billionaire wealth tax in November, Mark Zuckerberg would owe $10.5 billion in taxes & healthcare would be saved for 3 million low-income people.

Poor Mr. Zuckerberg would only have $200 billion left to feed his family. How will he survive?

author: BernieSanders
text:
The crypto industry has spent $189 million in campaign contributions so far this election cycle. Now they are pushing Congress to do their bidding by passing the corrupt CLARITY Act.

I’m talking to Ben McKenzie about what we can do to stop them. x.com/i/broadcasts/1qKDzzgAp…

author: BernieSanders
text:
WHY ARE THE BILLIONAIRES SO PANICKED BY ABDUL EL-SAYED?

The Democratic Senate primary in Michigan is much more than a campaign between Congresswoman Haley Stevens and Dr. Abdul El-Sayed. It is part of the ongoing struggle between Oligarchy and grassroots progressive politics. It is about whether we can create a government that represents ALL Americans, or one that continues to be controlled by wealthy campaign contributors.

As of today, billionaire-funded outside groups, led by AIPAC, have spent a record-breaking $50 million to support Haley Stevens — a roughly 60-to-1 advantage over Abdul El-Sayed. Let me repeat. A 60-to-1 advantage. Despite that, recent polling indicates that the race is extremely close — with some polls showing Abdul in the lead.

Why are the billionaires so panicked…

author: BernieSanders
text:
Last year Trump pocketed $1.4 billion from crypto deals. Now Congress wants to pass the CLARITY Act — a bill that could let his corruption continue.

Tune in tonight at 7PM ET as I talk to @ben_mckenzie about crypto fraud & scams and what Congress can do.

author: BernieSanders
text:
If Elon Musk, the richest man alive, really believes "money won't matter" in 2036, he'd support a 5% tax on his wealth & the wealth of other billionaires to make sure all Americans have a decent standard of living.

The fact that he doesn’t tells you everything you need to know.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Trump says “we have an amazing economy.”

Really?

60% of our people live paycheck to paycheck.
85 million are uninsured or underinsured.
More than 750,000 are homeless.
The price of groceries is through the roof.

If this is “amazing,” God help us.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Donavan McKinney will make a great member of Congress.  Thanks to these members for endorsing him. 

Despite all the money being spent against him, he’s going to win.

author: BernieSanders
text:
In the richest country on Earth, we should have a great standard of living for ALL our people, not massive income and wealth inequality.

The American people are tired of status quo politics.

They want change, real change.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Elon Musk Wealth
2012: $2 billion
2026: $719 billion

Jeff Bezos Wealth
2012: $18.4 billion
2026: $255 billion

Mark Zuckerberg Wealth
2012: $17.5 billion
2026: $212 billion

Federal Minimum Wage
2009: $7.25
2026: $7.25

Obscene. We must raise the minimum wage to a living wage.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Americans are tired of establishment politics, establishment economics and a corrupt campaign finance system.

They understand it is absurd for one man to own more wealth than the bottom half of society.

They understand healthcare is a human right. 

Americans want real change.

author: BernieSanders
text: They have the money. We have the people. Watch a great ad from Abdul’s campaign In Michigan.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Are we really living in a “democracy” when billionaire-funded super PACs can spend tens of millions trying to defeat great progressive Senate candidates like Abdul El-Sayed (MI) and Peggy Flanagan (MN)?

We need to end Citizens United and move to public funding of elections NOW!

author: BernieSanders
text:
Trump-backed billionaire David Ellison recently purchased CBS. Now he wants to take over CNN and the rest of Warner Bros.

A coalition of state attorneys general sued to stop it.

Now the deal is on hold. Good.  

We must stop corporate media consolidation.

author: BernieSanders
text:
No, Mr. Trump, Canada is not “poisoning our air.”
 
Climate change is fueling more wildfires, heat waves, floods and other extreme weather.
 
Stop blaming our allies and start standing up to your friends in Big Oil, who are driving the climate crisis.

author: BernieSanders
text:
The number of Amazon workers relying on food stamps and Medicaid nearly TRIPLED between 2020 and 2025.

Jeff Bezos is worth $257 billion and has a $500 million yacht.

He can afford to pay his workers a living wage.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Democratic establishment politics in action.

Outside groups, led by AIPAC, have spent $52.3 million in Michigan’s Senate primary to support Haley Stevens, compared to $853,000 in outside spending for Abdul El-Sayed — a 60-1 margin.

And the establishment is still going to lose.

author: BernieSanders
text:
12 billionaires are spending over $120 million against California's 5% billionaire wealth tax.
 
These guys are worth $420 billion, got $182 billion richer since Trump's election & own at least 25 mansions in CA worth $550 million.
 
We must end billionaire greed.

author: BernieSanders
text: washingtonpost.com/business/…

author: BernieSanders
text:
Since 2020, Walmart spent $37.6 billion in stock buybacks—enough to give all their workers a $23,550 bonus.

Instead, Walmart pays wages so low that many of their workers need Medicaid & SNAP paid for by taxpayers.

The real welfare queen is the Walton family worth $485 billion.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Some of the richest people in the country have now funneled more than $1.6 billion into the 2026 elections.

Democracy is one person, one vote — not billionaires buying elections.

We must end Citizens United and super PACs and move to public funding of elections.

author: BernieSanders
text:
A new AI model went rogue and hacked other computers. 

No, this is not science fiction. Uncontrolled AI poses a serious threat to all of us. 

We cannot continue the race to build and deploy this powerful technology until strong safeguards are in place.

CONGRESS MUST ACT.

author: BernieSanders
text:
A. Phillip Randolph is right:

“The essence of trade unionism is social uplift. The labor movement has been the haven for the dispossessed, the despised, the neglected, the downtrodden, the poor.”

Let's grow the trade union movement.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Trump is withholding $1 billion in Medicaid funds from California and Minnesota.

The same man who made $2 billion off the presidency and passed $1 trillion in tax cuts for the 1% is now taking away health care from thousands of poor children.

You can’t make this up.

author: BernieSanders
text:
AIPAC and other billionaire-funded super PACs have already spent nearly $50 million to defeat Dr. Abdul El-Sayed in the Michigan U.S. Senate primary.

We cannot allow oligarchs to buy our elections. One person, one vote.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Here’s how Trump's "Big Beautiful Bill" works:
 
The richest 1% get $1 trillion in tax breaks.
 
Working families get $1.1 trillion in cuts to SNAP, Medicaid and other healthcare programs.
 
Tens of thousands will go hungry so the wealthy can get another tax break. Shameful.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Thank you to a packed house in Minneapolis who came out to support @peggyflanagan. 

Together, we are going to take on crypto, the AI industry, AIPAC and other billionaire super PACs and send Peggy to the United States Senate.

author: BernieSanders
text:
The billionaires may have unlimited amounts of money, but we have something far more powerful. We have the people.

Minnesotans are going to show the country what organized people can do and elect Peggy Flanagan to the U.S. Senate. x.com/i/broadcasts/1nxeLLagR…

author: BernieSanders
text:
We’ve got a rally with Peggy Flanagan in Minneapolis tonight.

Despite being outspent 10 to 1 by the billionaires and their super PACS, Peggy is going to become the next U.S. Senator from Minnesota.

Let’s build the movement.

author: BernieSanders
BernieSanders
text:
Together, we can stand up to the billionaire class and create a government that represents working families. 

It’s time to vote for Abdul El-Sayed in the Michigan U.S. Senate primary on August 4. x.com/i/broadcasts/1nGeLLazV…

author: BernieSanders
text:
Thanks to our standing room only crowd in Lansing, Michigan. 

The establishment may have endless amounts of money. We have the people. 

When we’re organized, we win. Let’s support @AbdulElSayed.

author: BernieSanders
text:
The political establishment is getting nervous. 

We’re building a movement to take on concentrated wealth and power and create an economy that works for all. 

That's why we’re in Michigan to get out the vote for Dr. Abdul El-Sayed and Will Lawrence. x.com/i/broadcasts/1rGmqqwnB…

author: BernieSanders
text:
The Democratic primary in Michigan is not complicated. 

The billionaire class is pouring tens of millions of dollars into the establishment candidate. 

They want to maintain the status quo. We want real change. 

We’re supporting @AbdulElSayed.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Detroit. Thanks for the great turnout tonight.

Together, we’re going to take on AIPAC and the billionaire-funded super PACs trying to buy the election in Michigan.

We’re sending Abdul El-Sayed to the U.S. Senate.

author: BernieSanders
text:
The American people are sick and tired of status quo politics. 

They’re sick and tired of AIPAC and other billionaire-funded super PACs buying elections. 

They’re ready to elect leaders like Dr. Abdul El-Sayed and Donavan McKinney to Congress. x.com/i/broadcasts/1dxYllYgb…

author: BernieSanders
text:
“No business which depends for existence on paying less than living wages to its workers has any right to continue in this country.

By living wages I mean more than a bare subsistence level – I mean the wages of decent living.”

– President Franklin Delano Roosevelt, 1933

author: BernieSanders
text:
Corporate greed is UnitedHealth making a $5.48 billion profit last quarter (up 60% from last year), spending $33 billion in stock buybacks since 2022, paying its CEO over $60 million last year while it works to hike premiums by up to 25% next year.

Yes. We need Medicare for All.

author: BernieSanders
text:
The Oligarchs are getting nervous.

AIPAC and other billionaire-funded super PACs have already spent almost $50 million in Michigan to try and defeat Dr. Abdul El-Sayed.

They have the money. We have the people.

Fight back. Let’s support Abdul.

author: BernieSanders
text:
MICHIGAN: Join me, @AbdulElSayed, @AOC and more on Saturday and Sunday for a GOTV rally ahead of the August 4 primary.

We must tell AIPAC and other billionaire-funded super PACs: our democracy is not for sale.

author: BernieSanders
text:
At a time when millions of Americans are finding it harder to pay for groceries, housing and healthcare, when the climate crisis is causing record heatwaves and forest fires, Donald Trump felt it appropriate tonight to spew conspiracy theories about the 2020 election.

Pathetically, in true authoritarian fashion, he even threatened to revoke the licenses of ABC and NBC because they would not cover his speech. Insane.

Too many Americans have fought and died to defend American democracy.

All of us, regardless of our political views, must stand together against this dangerous president who is seeking to undermine our Constitution and our basic freedoms.

author: BernieSanders
text:
TRUMP’S LIES, CLIMATE CHANGE AND THE FUTURE OF THE PLANET

The last eleven years have been the hottest eleven years on record. The last three years have been the hottest three years on record. Europe just saw its worst heat wave in recorded history that set all-time heat records in seven countries, killed more than 10,000 people, and caused the worst heat stress ever in half of the continent’s largest cities. 

Much of the American west just saw its warmest winter on record, and as a country, the United States just saw its worst spring drought in recorded history. This summer alone we have seen multiple record heatwaves that have exposed hundreds of millions of Americans to dangerous levels of heat. 
 
In both the United States and Canada, this heat and drought is driving longer and more …

author: BernieSanders
text:
Yes, President Trump is right.

The $1 trillion in tax breaks his "Big Beautiful Bill" gave to the top 1% helped his wealthy friend buy a private jet that "he didn't need."

Meanwhile, that same bill is throwing millions of Americans off of the healthcare they desperately need.

author: BernieSanders
text: We cannot allow billionaire super PACs to destroy American democracy.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Trump promised to cap credit card interest rates at 10%.

He lied.

Last quarter, while working people struggle to pay their bills, big banks made a $49 billion profit charging 25-30% credit card interest rates.

We must take on the outrageous greed and usury of Wall Street.

author: BernieSanders
text:
AIPAC is now spending 8x as much as Abdul El-Sayed's entire campaign on the MI Senate primary.

This race is not between Abdul and Haley Stevens. It is Abdul vs. AIPAC.

A billionaire-funded Super PAC shouldn't determine American elections or foreign policy. Let's support Abdul.

author: BernieSanders
text:
1. Larry Ellison spent $45 million to elect Trump.

2. Trump's DOJ approved Ellison's takeover of CNN & CBS.

In a democracy, the president does not control the media. 

State AGs must block the Ellison-led Paramount-Warner Bros. merger.

author: BernieSanders
text:
In the midst of the wars in Gaza and Iran, we cannot forget the atrocities in Sudan.

As many as 150,000 killed since 2023
14 million driven from their homes
30 million need humanitarian aid

All of this is fueled by the UAE — one of Trump's closest allies.

We cannot be complicit in genocide.

author: BernieSanders
text:
69% of Americans support my bill to give the public a 50% ownership stake in AI companies.

The American people understand that AI must work for ALL of us, and not just make a handful of Big Tech billionaires even richer.

author: BernieSanders
text:
MINNESOTA: Join me, @peggyflanagan, along with special guests @IlhanMN and @keithellison next Monday in Minneapolis for a Many Over the Money GOTV rally ahead of the August 11 primary.

Together, let’s build a government that takes on the greed of the billionaire class.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Billionaires get richer while working families struggle.

The U.S. is in decline.

How do we turn that around and create an economy that works for ALL? We knock on doors and build our grassroots movement. 

They have the money.  We have the people.

ORGANIZE. ORGANIZE. ORGANIZE.

author: BernieSanders
text:
When you see political ads, think about who’s paying for them:

AI super PACs have amassed a war chest of over $200 million and crypto has already spent $288 million.

Now, AIPAC is spending tens of millions in Michigan against @AbdulElSayed.

We must end Citizens United!

author: BernieSanders
text:
After demanding that the hosts be fired, the Trump administration is now threatening to take away ABC broadcast licenses because Trump doesn’t like its talk show, The View.

Mr. President: this is not a dictatorship. In a democracy, you cannot shut down media outlets just because they are critical of you.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Yes. @RBReich is right. If the rapid advancement in AI destroys tens of millions of jobs as many Big Tech Oligarchs predict, who will be able to afford to purchase the products they are pushing?

The economic gains of AI must benefit humanity, not just a handful of billionaires.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Trump ousted all three members of the U.S. Election Assistance Commission, a bipartisan agency that works with state officials to ensure free and fair elections.

Nice try, Mr. President. 

We won't let you sabotage the midterm elections. This is a democracy, not a dictatorship.

author: BernieSanders
text:
President Trump: Instead of insulting Europeans, why don’t we learn something from them.

In Denmark, for example, everyone is guaranteed healthcare, college education is free, parents receive one year of paid family leave and workers don’t make less than $22 an hour.

author: BernieSanders
text:
.@EdMarkey has been my partner in fighting for Medicare for All, ensuring every person earns a living wage and transforming our rigged economic and political systems so that they work for ordinary Americans.

That's why I'm endorsing him for his reelection for the U.S. Senate.

author: BernieSanders
text:
After getting the United States into a war based on lies, Trump has now declared the ceasefire with Iran "over" after less than a month.
 
Restarting his reckless war with Iran won't make America stronger. It will cost more lives and waste more taxpayer dollars.
 
END THIS WAR

author: BernieSanders
text:
We need leaders in Congress who understand firsthand the struggles facing working families and are ready to fight for unions, affordable housing, Medicare for All, and an economy that works for everyone, not just the 1%.

Let's send @AbdulElSayed to the Senate.

author: BernieSanders
text:
We have a fundamental choice to make.

We can maintain a broken healthcare system that allows insurance companies to make billions by raising premiums by 14%-35% next year.

Or we can enact Medicare for All and save the American people $650 billion a year.

Which side are you on?
